title: Book of Wildfire becomes a different Book at the end of your turn
notes: Classic #55 Book of Wildfire gains "End of turn: Become a different Book." (Radiant: "… a different Radiant Book."): at the end of its owner's turn, while in hand, it becomes a random other Book (never Wildfire, never the Book it is), on its own face, which keeps swapping each turn (R671).
